diagnostics.ambiguity: Distances permit reflected map/tag solutions; no reflection is removed by alignment. In 3D, reflection across the first-three plane preserves canonical anchors; supported below bounds may select a branch.

constraints.separation_note: Below inequalities select a branch; they neither fix a tag plane nor add range measurements

gauge.description: Planar xy translation/rotation gauge: b0xy=0, b1y=0, b1x>0; tag datum supplies z origin
gauge.local_rank_note: After valid gauge removal, measurement rank deficits disclose first-order information loss; they may indicate continuous ambiguity or singular sensitivity, requiring additional analysis
gauge.remaining_reflections: Distances permit reflected map/tag solutions; no reflection is removed by alignment. In 3D, reflection across the first-three plane preserves canonical anchors; supported below bounds may select a branch.

truth_beacon_planarity.interpretation: Best-fit-plane departure; normal is underdetermined for collinear/stationary point clouds

truth_planarity.interpretation: Best-fit-plane departure; normal is underdetermined for collinear/stationary point clouds

native_model_projection.note: Canonical truth projected through selected M5 native model/bounds and positive height branch; evaluation only, not optimizer lower bound

robust_estimation.decision_rule: hard_rejection: zero frozen pilot weight; otherwise influence weight strictly less than weight_decision_threshold
robust_estimation.label_access: Evaluation only; fitter receives assumed times, epoch/beacon, ranges/sigmas and declared surveyed map
robust_estimation.loss_assumptions: Symmetric residual losses handle positive injected bias without knowing its sign/labels. No explicit per-beacon bias variables are fitted. Joint geometry can absorb contamination; low residual and optimizer convergence do not prove accuracy.

solver_comparison.lm_limitations: Retained+prior residual count must cover parameter count; strict interior bounds; exponential overflow/underflow may fail and remain inspectable
solver_comparison.objective: Original unsquared range residual/sigma plus separately disclosed M4 motion and height priors
solver_comparison.physical_rank_note: Original and retained information use physical metre coordinates; native h/q sensitivity is separately disclosed

trajectory_model.prior_definition: Time-weighted interior-knot deviation inxyz divided by prior_sigma_m; soft height is a separate prior

truth_augmented_jacobian.interpretation: Augmented rank includes physical/model assumptions, not new measurement information
truth_augmented_jacobian.scaling: All coordinates in metres; normalized residual Jacobian with respect to theta/median-range scale

truth_interpolation_floor.definition: Truth projected onto gauge and selected height model, then knots/interpolation; combined representation/model mismatch, not optimizer lower bound
truth_interpolation_floor.outside_domain_rule: Endpoint hold only for actual-time evaluation

truth_interpolation_only.definition: Canonical truth sampled at knots and interpolated without imposing tag or beacon height models

truth_jacobian.interpretation: Local measurement-only rank after gauge removal; full rank does not prove global uniqueness
truth_jacobian.scaling: All coordinates in metres; normalized residual Jacobian with respect to theta/median-range scale

truth_model_projection.definition: Selected tag/beacon height models projected at canonical truth knots, before time interpolation

acquisition_metadata.delivery_latency_rule: delivery_time_s=actual_time_s+latency; never used in batch fitting
acquisition_metadata.grouping_rule: assume every ping in epoch occurs at estimator_input.times_s[epoch]
acquisition_metadata.range_noise_pairing: fixed Gaussian draw indexed by cycle and beacon, independent of missingness and timing

generation.dropout_definition: Independent Bernoulli selection after M5 acquisition selection; source pings and dropped records retained; missingness is not an estimator rejection.
generation.label_definition: nlos marks injected positive NLOS bias only; offsets, white/AR noise and quantization are separate factors
generation.nlos_prevalence_definition: Independent Bernoulli burst-onset probability per eligible beacon/cycle; forward union of duration-cycle windows. Realized contaminated fraction can exceed onset probability.
generation.noise_definition: AR(1) per beacon, stationary SD in metres, independent beacon streams; correlation is between adjacent cycle indices, not elapsed seconds. Base M5 white noise remains additive.
generation.order: M5 acquisition/white noise, beacon offset, stationary cycle-grid AR(1), positive NLOS, nearest-even quantization, independent dropout
generation.randomness: NumPy default_rng, SeedSequence(seed).spawn(3): onset, AR innovations, dropout
generation.uncertainty_definition: sigma_m is the original assumed M5 range SD; not silently inflated for contamination or quantization

source_experiment.coordinate_convention: World Cartesian metres for synthetic truth/surveyed maps; estimator joint gauge is separately disclosed in run diagnostics

motion.endpoint_rule: Position holds at path endpoints and outside [0,duration]; speed is zero while held
motion.height_parameterization: tilted: z=offset+tan(tilt)*(x-5m); excursion: offset+A*sin(2pi*t/T); spatial adds .45A*sin(6pi*t/T+.2); endpoint times hold
motion.path_parameterization: reference path arclength; narrow coverage uses dense polyline
motion.profile_node_units: fraction of duration, signed relative speed; variable profile normalized by peak forward excursion

solver.derivatives: Analytic M5 h/q Jacobian times exact range-loss and optional bound coordinate chain rules
solver.loss_implementation: Analytic signed-sqrt rho residual transform; exact objective, transformed-residual Gauss-Newton approximation. Priors never robustified; SciPy loss=linear
solver.loss_units: Dimensionless normalized range residual: (predicted-measured)/original assumed sigma_m
solver.objective: .5*c²*sum rho((range_residual/sigma/c)²) plus quadratic motion/height priors; hard rejection substitutes a frozen binary pilot mask

parameterization.objective: Original unsquared range residual/sigma plus separately disclosed M4 motion and height priors

solver.rejection_rule: Gaussian pilot from saved physical start; retain abs(pilot residual/sigma)<=threshold; one second Gaussian fit initialized at pilot geometry with frozen mask; no label access
solver.rejection_support: All rows remain in saved diagnostics; rejected range residual rows have zero optimizer weight. At least one retained range required; LM requires retained+prior count >= parameter count.
